result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and signalized crossings in a mixed-use urban setting. However, safety is compromised by significantly faded crosswalk markings and parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines at the corners.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are significantly worn and degraded, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection crossing

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner block sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the curb line

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The narrow sidewalk lacks any physical buffer, such as trees or bollards, to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk along the building frontages

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental or ladder patterns to improve driver awareness and compliance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The intersection is characterized by wide roadways and faded pedestrian markings, creating a high-exposure environment. The industrial setting lacks significant pedestrian-oriented design, with narrow sidewalks and no visible refuge islands or dedicated signals.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk paint is heavily worn, making the pedestrian crossing area less visible to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the left-hand approach of the intersection.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median refuge, increasing time spent in the conflict zone.
hazards.location_in_image: The main expanse of the intersection between the corners.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are placed directly in the narrow sidewalk path, restricting effective width for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk on the left side of the image.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded markings with high-visibility continental or ladder-style crosswalks to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and dedicated pedestrian signals despite the presence of traffic lights. Sidewalks are narrow and obstructed by utility poles, creating a hostile environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks at a signalized intersection, increasing the risk of pedestrian-vehicle conflicts.
hazards.location_in_image: Center intersection area

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles and signs are placed in the middle of the narrow sidewalk, impeding movement.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground sidewalk

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: Absence of curb ramps makes the intersection inaccessible for people with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint high-visibility continental crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all crossing points.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers synchronized with the traffic lights.

result.summary: The intersection is controlled by traffic signals but lacks high-visibility crosswalk markings and dedicated pedestrian signal heads. The pavement is in poor condition with significant cracking, and parked vehicles near the corner create visual obstructions for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded or Missing Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The lack of clear, visible crosswalk markings fails to alert drivers to the presence of a pedestrian crossing zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Significant cracking and degradation of the asphalt surface can create trip hazards and affect vehicle braking.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image near the corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the corner to improve sightlines for all road users.
